items.label: Turnover package includes plates, camera data, and shot-specific notes
Handles included on all plates per the agreed handle length
Offline-to-online conform path confirmed (no missing/renamed shots)
EDL/AAF/XML exported and validated against the cut before sending
Plates delivered in agreed colorspace/format (e.g. ACEScg EXR, LogC ProRes)
Slate/metadata (shot name, frame range, lens, colorspace) attached to every plate
Vendor confirms receipt and successful ingest of plates
Reference cut/QuickTime provided alongside plates for context
Vendor submissions reviewed against shot notes and previs/reference
Notes delivered back to vendor with clear, actionable feedback
Director/client approval tracked per shot (WIP, approved, final)
Approved shots confirmed conformed back into the cut
Burn tracked against bid per vendor, updated regularly
Change orders issued for any shot added, re-scoped, or upresed beyond bid
Contingency spend tracked separately from base budget
Cost report shared with production on the agreed cadence
Finals delivered in the spec'd codec, resolution, and colorspace
File naming follows the agreed convention across all vendors
QC pass done on every final (no drop frames, artifacts, or slate errors)
Finals conformed into the final online timeline and verified
Archival copies of plates, finals, and project files stored per retention policy
Vendor contracts closed out, final invoices reconciled against burn report
Post-mortem notes captured for pipeline/vendor learnings on the next show
